candidate_reports.remark: 57 kt outflow wind gust observed at NWS Reno office.
Total rainfall in less than an hour at Hawthorne Industrial Arport. Peak wind gust 46 mph.
Thunderstorm produced nearly all the reported rain in a 35 minute period between 220 and 255 pm. Minor back yard flooding also reported at the spotters home.
Minor flooding and erosion along a dirt access road and through washes at the Hawthorne Industrial Airport. Small deposit of mud on one of the taxiways and standing water near some beacon lights_ but
Mudslide reported at Fish Springs Road and Jo Lane. Fish Springs Road closed.
Eastbound Glendale Ave. closed at Bergin Way due to flooding.
